messages:
maya: FYI — Snyk flagged CVE-2026-1987 in tokenizers 0.15.4; upstream patched in 0.15.6. Poetry lock regen + pip wheel changes are blowing up CI on manylinux/macOS runners. Need triage and rollout plan.
sec-bot: [scanner] tokenizers 0.15.4 - CVE-2026-1987 - HIGH - out-of-tree deserialization. Details: https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-TOKENIZERS-1987
samir: can you paste repro + failing CI job id? classify severity/P1? :interrobang:
maya: repro in local env. Failing job: pipeline #4921. Error snippet:
```bash
ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
Building wheel for tokenizers (pyproject.toml) ... error
OSError: [Errno 22] Invalid argument
```
john: looks like manylinux/macos wheel tag mismatch. poetry lock bumped tokenizers -> 0.15.6 which requires newer rust flags. CI runners are on older docker images without updated cargo/rustc.
ara: I'd mark this P1 for public-hosted endpoints since tokenizer-service touches text ingestion. Canary first, but we should accelerate. Also, confirm no private key exposure; unrelated to KMS but check audit logs.
samir: proposed plan:
  1) pin tokenizers to 0.15.6 in constraints + regen lockfile in a branch
  2) update CI build images (rust 1.70, musl/manylinux2014)
  3) produce prebuilt wheels for macOS and upload to internal artifactory as fallback
  4) run staged canary on staging then prod with monitoring and rollback points
  5) backport to 0.15.5 if needed for older infra
maya: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizer-service/pull/128 — contains lockfile + Dockerfile updates. CI still red on macos-latest due to wheel building differences.
dev-ci-bot: pipeline #4926 started for PR 128; macos-latest job failed: exit code 1; logs uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ci/logs/4926/macos-job.log
john: alternate mitigation — publish a binary wheel built from our build image (universal2) and use --find-links in CI to fetch it. Avoids local mac builder flakiness. Need to check upstream license and signing.
maya: I'll build the universal2 wheel locally, sign it, and upload to artifactory. Then add a temporary pip config in CI to use the internal index.
samir: timeline?
maya: aiming for canary deploy tomorrow 09:30 PST. ara + john can own monitoring and rollback. I'll coordinate the artifactory upload and update PR.
ara: adding to oncall checklist: verify tokenization latency, 99th percentile CPU, and memory after deploy. Also check audit logs for any unusual key usage (KMS) during the build pipeline.
maya: notes for release notes / support: mention potential brief tokenization latency bumps, include rollback instructions, and link to CVE advisory. I'll update PR description with step-by-step.
samir: OK. Prioritizing as P1. If we observe exploit attempts or customer reports, escalate to P0 and fire incident.
maya: thanks everyone — action items in PR description. Closing triage thread. :thumbsup:
